title: IRC: honour JOIN 0 (leave every room)
description: Mark decided 2026-11-20: JOIN 0 is honoured as IRC defines it: leave every room, for real (§7.1, PART leaves). The v1 front end (mimid-1vul.8) refuses it; change that, record as §7.12 in docs/design/agent-frontends.md, and test that JOIN 0 parts every channel and each room becomes Leaving/Left in the store.
